item.title: Rats ‘wait for breakfast’ as gulls rip open restaurant bags
item.description: By Avril Horan SEAGULLS searching for food are tearing open plastic bags full of scraps left on city streets by restaurants after dark. As a result, Cllr Frank Fahy (FG) has called for new byelaws to stop the use of plastic bags for commercial food waste. item.description: By Ronan Judge A serial offender who repeatedly struck another woman during an assault on the grounds of a church in Westside has received an eight month prison sentence. item.title: Residents don’t want the Galway City Council to cut their hedges
item.description: By Avril Horan Residents of Grattan Park are involved in a dispute with city officials over hedge cutting — they don’t want it to happen.
